description: The purpose of the line plot is to illustrate the accuracy of the Ex1 and Ex2 models over a series of steps. The x-axis represents the step number, ranging from 0 to 60000, and the y-axis represents the accuracy of the next token prediction, ranging from 0.10 to 0.40. The Ex1 Accuracy line is represented by a blue line with circle markers, while the Ex2 Accuracy line is represented by a green line with circle markers. Both lines show an increase in accuracy as the number of steps increases, with the Ex1 Accuracy line consistently higher than the Ex2 Accuracy line throughout the plot.
